create_STrack: create an STrack object for single-object tracking with bounding box, score, and Kalman filter
build_STrack_multi_predict: build multi-object prediction by calling STrack.multi_predict on a list of tracks with shared Kalman filter
activate_STrack: activate a new STrack tracklet with Kalman filter initialization and frame ID assignment
update_STrack: update an existing STrack track with new detection data and Kalman filter measurement update
convert_STrack_bounding_box: convert STrack bounding box between TLWH, TLBR, and XYAH coordinate formats
